policy: Only fields supported by the completed Awoken research batches are eligible for canonical enrichment. Unresolved or conflicting values are retained as notes rather than guessed canonical values.

records.name: Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Capsule Corporation Time Rift; complete the Saiyan transformation quest chain.
records.mechanics_notes: +10% Strike, +5% Ki Blast, +5% Strike Defense; Ki regeneration penalty varies by stage. Stage chain: Super Saiyan -> Super Saiyan 2 -> Super Saiyan 3.

records.name: Super Saiyan God
records.unlock_method: Use Shenron's Super Saiyan God wish after completing the required Saiyan friendship progression.
records.mechanics_notes: Current research supports +60% Basic Attack, +60% Ki recovery and +12.5% movement speed; does not directly increase Strike/Ki Blast skill damage.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Reach the required high-level progression and max Whis friendship, then complete the Whis unlock interaction.
records.mechanics_notes: +25% all attack and current research supports reduced damage taken; sustained Ki-drain behavior is version-sensitive and retained in research notes.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
records.unlock_method: High-level Saiyan progression with max Vegeta/Whis friendship and mentor progression; exact current checkpoint remains source-sensitive.
records.mechanics_notes: +35% all attack and +10% damage resistance; current research records an 18% Ki-recovery/drain penalty.

records.name: Future Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Collect the five Distorted Time Eggs and complete the resulting Unknown History/Special Time Patrol story sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: +10% Strike and +5% Ki Blast; current research treats the faster Stamina regeneration behavior as authoritative and flags conflicting in-game wording.

records.name: Super Vegeta
records.unlock_method: Capsule Corporation Time Rift; complete Vegeta's additional transformation challenge.
records.mechanics_notes: +5% Strike, +10% Ki Blast and +5% Blast Defense. Stage 2 is Super Vegeta 2.

records.name: Purification
records.unlock_method: Progress through Majin Buu's House Time Rift until the required Buu-child/faction progression is complete, then complete the associated transformation challenge.
records.mechanics_notes: Replaces the normal moveset with a Kid Buu-style moveset; current research records transformation-specific Stamina/resource behavior. Sources disagree on some intermediate Buu-child requirements.

records.name: Become Giant
records.unlock_method: Complete the Guru's House/Namekian Awakening quest progression and associated Piccolo/Nail sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: Giant Namekian moveset with hyper armor; maintained technical research records 20 Stamina/sec and restricted Ultimate/evasive use.

records.name: Turn Golden
records.unlock_method: Complete the Frieza's Spaceship Time Rift quest chain and final Frieza/Cold-family progression.
records.mechanics_notes: +30% Ki Blast and +20% movement speed; resource behavior remains version-sensitive in the research corpus.

records.name: Power Pole Pro
records.unlock_method: Level 35 and completion of the Great Saiyaman/Hercule's House questline.
records.mechanics_notes: Nimbus and Power Pole moveset; transformation ends on hitstun or grab.

records.name: Kaioken
records.unlock_method: Chance to obtain from Parallel Quest 8 Ultimate Finish.
records.mechanics_notes: Base stage of the Kaioken chain. Higher stages are Kaioken x3 and Kaioken x20.

records.name: Potential Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Z-rank the prerequisite Advancement Tests, then complete the unlocked Super Class Advancement Test.
records.mechanics_notes: +15% all attack and +5% defense in current research. Sources disagree on whether the 500 Ki requirement is represented as consumed or merely required; this remains explicitly unresolved.

records.name: Beast
records.unlock_method: Max friendship with the required Gohan/Piccolo mentor progression and complete the special Cell Max training battle.
records.mechanics_notes: Consumes 500 Ki on activation; +30% all attack, +20% damage taken, +20% Ki recovery.

records.name: Ultra Instinct
records.unlock_method: Current acquisition route is associated with Jiren/special training content; exact current source remains unresolved between competing guides.
records.mechanics_notes: Current-version correction: requires 500 Ki but no longer consumes the five Ki bars on activation. No base attack/defense modifier; auto-dodge costs 100 Stamina and the counter mechanic has a 100 Ki cost.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.unlock_method: Progress through Future Saga Chapter 4 content until the Awoken skill is awarded.
records.mechanics_notes: Two-stage transformation. Current 2026 research supports a roughly 12-second second stage with effectively unlimited/rapid Ki and health drain; exact cooldown and some stage-1 values remain unresolved.

excluded_note: These are staged forms represented through their parent Awoken records rather than separate canonical transformation records.
